data_quality.note: 12 of 43 historical constituents have no yfinance price history (delisted or acquired names, plus identifiers yfinance does not resolve — e.g. ATVI, CBS, CTL, DISCA, DISCK, DISH, DISHR, IPG). They are dropped from both numerator and denominator, which biases breadth toward survivors until a delisted-price source is integrated. Daily n_with_price vs n_constituents lets Step 3 quarantine suspect periods.
